summaries.demographer: Jeffrey Mullins is a 36-year-old white, non-Hispanic married man living in Defiance, Missouri, with his wife Emily and no children or roommates (Q51-Q55, Q84-Q89). He has a bachelor's degree in a STEM-related field and works full-time as a USPS mail carrier in St. Charles County (Q16, Q65, Q90). His household is economically stable, owning a mortgaged home and relying on two full-time incomes, with moderate savings and no public assistance (Q58, Q61, Q74, Q80). His life-course profile reflects a rooted Midwestern adult household with strong family ties, public-sector employment, and aging-parent responsibilities (Q05, Q35, Q97-Q107).
summaries.behavioral_economist: Jeffrey shows high conscientiousness around budgeting, savings, and route efficiency, using spreadsheets, emergency funds, and practical optimization to reduce uncertainty (Q57, Q61, Q65, Q82). He is moderately risk-averse financially, able to absorb a $400 shock but cautious about health, home, and car repair risks (Q59-Q64, Q82-Q83). He has a known temptation toward camera gear purchases, but manages it by delaying purchases when expenses rise (Q60-Q61). His choices are shaped by stable routines, public-service identity, and a preference for long-term security over short-term status (Q02-Q04, Q66, Q108).
summaries.political_scientist: Jeffrey is a regular voter and moderate Independent who leans somewhat Democratic, especially on labor, health care, public services, environmental stewardship, and social issues (Q23-Q24, Q95-Q96). His USPS employment and union membership increase his institutional attachment to public service while also making him attentive to bureaucratic inefficiency (Q24, Q65-Q66). He is concerned about race, policing, and inequality, responding mainly through private conversations, learning, and modest local donations rather than protest participation (Q26-Q30). His civic orientation is localist, practical, and community-service oriented (Q07, Q17, Q23, Q108).
summaries.psychologist: Jeffrey presents as disciplined, compassionate, modest, and systems-minded, with a self-concept organized around reliability, service, and practical competence (Q01-Q04, Q109). He regulates stress through routines, photography, hiking, cycling, talking with Emily, and reducing social media exposure (Q43-Q45, Q50). He reports mild anxiety during high-stress periods but no major diagnosed mental health condition, and he tends to become quiet, detail-focused, and over-responsible under strain (Q43-Q45). Relationally, he relies on a small trusted network and prefers steady, low-drama connection over broad social exposure (Q05-Q07, Q49).
